name: Riverside Public Library Foundation
missionShort: The Riverside Public Library Foundation raises funds to ensure the excellence of library services for Riverside residents.
missionLong: We are a fundraising foundation, separate from the Riverside Public Library itself. We do not run the libraries. We raise the money that helps them do more: new books and e-materials, story time kits, homework help, computers, and the buildings and rooms people use every day.

legacyProgram.name: Literary Legacy Program
legacyProgram.blurb: Help us support Riverside's libraries through this 5-year fundraising program.

campaign.name: Lifelong Learning for an Informed & Healthy Riverside
campaign.blurb: This year's funds will support programming inspired by Blue Zones research promoting longevity, social connection and purpose.
